verdict.rationale: Bulk operations are a fair question for a shared-inbox product, but the evidence never documents multi-select actions, batch API endpoints, or bulk edits across many conversations. What the pack does show is adjacent and earns no credit: per-conversation automation rules, an Auto-archive 'Everyone' setting, API rate limits, and MCP agents that summarize or triage conversations.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can perform bulk operations across many items at once
